content:
maya: quick health check for KiteWave — can we post p95/p99 by route+model and streaming vs non-streaming for last 7d? include error rate and any spend flags.
jordan: quick dump, 7d rolling:
- /generate | model=gpt-neox-20b | streaming: p95=210ms p99=420ms | err=0.6% (mostly 429)
- /generate | model=gpt-neox-20b | non-streaming: p95=320ms p99=760ms | err=0.3%
- /embed | model=s-instruct-6b | streaming: p95=85ms p99=210ms | err=0.1%
- /rerank | model=s-rank-1 | non-streaming: p95=410ms p99=940ms | err=1.8% (OOM + tokenization)
observations: streaming reduces tail substantially for small payloads (generate), but we see higher 429s during bursts. rerank remains problematic on p99 and errors.
samir: thanks. do we know if the 429s correlate with concurrent_streams or token length?
jordan: correlation looks like concurrent connections + sudden spike in short requests. token length low. suspect autoscale/graceful-backoff thresholds insufficient for streaming bursts.
cs_bot: Billing alert — KiteWave forecasted spend +18% vs committed this month; overage risk if trend continues.
olivia: onboarding notes: prod keys rotated last Tue, integration tests green. Customer requested SLA target: p95 <200ms on /generate.
maya: flagging potential renewal risk if we can't get p95 under 200ms. Jordan, can you run a quantized variant canary next week and see p95 impact? Also, Ops to review autoscale for streaming.
jordan: will spin up an 8-bit quantized variant on a dedicated pool tomorrow; plan to route 5% traffic canary. I'll post perf snapshot once stable.
samir: I'll look into adjusting autoscale thresholds + backoff for streaming to reduce 429s. Also opening support ticket for rerank OOMs.
jordan: quick diagnostic query I'm using:
```
SELECT route, model_variant, mode, percentile(latency_ms, 95) AS p95, percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, count(*) as req_count
FROM redwood_requests
WHERE org_id='kitewave' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```
olivia: action items for CS: 1) Share performance plan with customer by Wed (maya) 2) Confirm canary schedule and rollback criteria (jordan) 3) Inform finance about forecasted overage and potential mitigation credits (olivia)
maya: I'll draft the customer note and set a sync for Thu. tagging @jordan @samir @olivia. :+1:
jordan: uploaded canary perf snapshot: https://redwood.internal/canaries/kitewave/1938456123
samir: support ticket created for rerank OOMs: #SUP-7648
cs_bot: Reminder — weekly health check for KiteWave in 7 days. Thank you everyone.
